# FG-GIT-0020

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`repo-maintenance`](../../ops/runbooks/repo-maintenance.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_stale_packed_refs_lock_is_reported` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: リポジトリの ref のロックが残っています。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: A ref lock of the repository was left behind. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Kunci ref repositori tertinggal. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

`packed-refs.lock` exists in a repository and nothing is writing it: a git that held it was killed without its signal handlers running (SIGKILL, a Windows TerminateProcess, a host crash). While it stays, every push that deletes a packed ref (a branch or tag that pack-refs packed, a version ref purge) and every `update-ref` that needs it fails after the 10 s wait (`core.packedRefsTimeout`), and the maintenance's pack-refs fails too. The maintenance removes the lock its own killed pack-refs left (only when it is not older than the step, under the merge lock); a lock older than the step is someone else's and is left for a person (M3 O3 review).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Two sources: the maintenance job (`event=forge.git.maintenance_lock_left`, error level, `repo_id`, `age_secs`, `request_id` of the job) after a failed pack-refs found a lock older than its step; `forge doctor` `repositories.stale_locks` found `packed-refs.lock` older than 10 minutes (`repositories`, `max_age_secs`, `repo_ids`, `checked`, `truncated`). Read-only: `forge admin repo-path <repo_id> --storage-root <root>`, `ls -la <path>/packed-refs.lock` (time), and whether a git runs on that path (`pgrep -af 'git.*<repo_id>.git'` / Task Manager).

## 対処 (fix)

When no git runs on the repository and the lock is older than the longest push (`git.http.timeout_ms`, default 1 h): [MUTATING — needs approval] move it aside (`mv <path>/packed-refs.lock <path>/packed-refs.lock.stale-<date>`; rollback: move it back), then `git --git-dir=<path> show-ref | head` and `forge admin repo maintain <repo_id>`. Never remove a lock while a git process on that repository is running (runbook repo-maintenance).
